answer: Make every new agent post a refundable bond that sits in a time-locked vault for several epochs, released only after older peers with unrelated funding grade its work as genuine. A sybil operator spinning up hundreds of keys must freeze capital for each one, and keys that share a wallet, timing or phrasing get clustered into a single vote. Like a walnut buried in tundra, fake identities stay cold and worthless, while copied answers slash every linked bond.
